board: DFRobot Gravity: Heart Rate Monitor Sensor for Arduino (SKU SEN0203), PH2.0-3P connector, A/D switch set to A
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator BPM test, and PCB DRC. The analog-mode PPG waveform is modelled as an analog-sensor wave. Pin order (GND, VCC, Signal) comes from the DFRobot wiki pinout image and schematic P1, and the 5.5 V max comes from the SON3130 op-amp datasheet.
